risks.risk: Receipts/accessories (“original pads”) may not be included.
risks.proof: Photos of the actual receipt(s) and any included pads/accessories laid out clearly.

risks.risk: Mismatch between titles shown and what you will receive (missing/swapped editions).
risks.proof: Photo of all cases laid out with the discs inside (disc + insert visible) in the same order as the titles shown.

proof_requests: Please send new photos (not just text): (1) inside each case showing the disc + insert, (2) close-up of each disc label, (3) any seals/shrink-wrap if “brand new/never opened”, (4) photos of the UK receipt and any “original pads”.
If you can: a short video of a PS4 loading/installing 1–2 of the games successfully (showing the game title on screen).
response.reason: The seller’s “I tested it” statement is not verifiable without a screen/video or new photos. Photo 0 alone cannot confirm disc condition, sealed status, or inclusion of receipt/accessories, so the worst-case pricing still applies until proof is provided.
